name: Orb · SHDR-16
description: Sunlight through water: a caustic net crawling over the ball. Two crossed families of crest lines, their crossings added back so the foci burn hottest, read through a three-octave sine fold that refracts the net rather than scrolling it, and mapped triplanar so the ball can turn forever with no pole and no seam. The net is sampled at three moments, one per channel, so edges fringe into colour only where they move. A surge on an integrated clock lifts gain and ripple depth together. Thinking runs fast, thin and cold; speaking heaves in long gold breaths on wine-dark water (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-16 (MIT).
